called_shot.name: Called Shot
called_shot.description: Precise aimed shot with +25% accuracy and 1.3x damage.

suppressing_fire.name: Suppressing Fire
suppressing_fire.description: Pins down enemies in area. Suppressed units lose AP next turn.

field_medic.name: Field Medic
field_medic.description: Expert medical treatment. Heals 50 HP and clears bleeding.

breach_and_clear.name: Breach & Clear
breach_and_clear.description: Destroy adjacent door/wall and get a free move into the room.

rally.name: Rally
rally.description: Inspire nearby allies. Grants +2 AP to all allies in radius.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.description: Reserve AP to fire at the first enemy that moves in line of sight.

hunker_down.name: Hunker Down
hunker_down.description: Double current cover bonus. Cannot act until next turn.
